    obj = get_name_in_module(module, qualname)
    if not callable(obj):
        raise InvalidTypeError(f"{module}.{qualname} is not callable")
    if isinstance(obj, types.BuiltinMethodType):
        # For bound methods, we want the underlying function, not the bound object
        return obj.__func__

        # For properties, we want the getter function
        return obj.fget

def get_name_in_module(module: str, qualname: str, attr_getter: Optional[
    Callable[[Any, str], Any]]=None) ->Any:
    mod = importlib.import_module(module)
    if attr_getter is None:
        attr_getter = getattr
    obj = mod
    for name in qualname.split("."):
        obj = attr_getter(obj, name)
    return obj
